name: TC-03-master-data-organization
description: TC-03.1: Organization, Site, Department Hierarchy — Create and verify organizational structure

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Organization List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Organization in the sidebar. This page shows all registered organizations. Organizations are the top level of the hierarchy: Organization → Site → Department.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Create Organization
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a new Organization. Fill in the name and other required fields.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Fill Organization Name
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Test Corporation" into the Organization Name field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Organization Saved
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Create' to save the organization. A success notification confirms the record was created with an auto-generated ID.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the success toast and saved organization.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.1 — Organization Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The organization record is now saved. You can see the auto-generated ID and all fields. Navigate to Site to create sites linked to this organization.
